description: React functional component 'NotesApp' that manages notes interface, integrating child components (Sidebar, TopBar, Editor), state management, and UI logic for creating, updating, deleting notes, with loading states and confirmation dialogs.

methods.name: onNew
methods.description: Triggers creation of a new note.

methods.name: onDelete

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms or cancels the delete operation based on user input.
